output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) ORDER BY order_year
output.explanation: Sums net revenue by calendar year of the order date, counting only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue). Shipping fees are not added. The current year, 2026, is only partial if the data runs up to today.
